name: Koshinzuka
tagline: Shinjuku in 26 minutes and Otemachi in 32 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 26 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 50 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 25.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 25.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 20.7 m to 26.5 m, a difference of 5.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 久保田病院, about 6 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 山口病院, about 9 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line).
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line). It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. a small projected flood depth pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Shin-Koshinzuka; for the number of places to eat out, Koshinzuka.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Koshinzuka. It is served by the same lines as Koshinzuka. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. A one-room flat costs about ¥6,000 less at Shin-Koshinzuka. On what it offers families, Shin-Koshinzuka comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Nishi-Sugamo; for the number of places to eat out, Koshinzuka.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Koshinzuka. Koshinzuka adds the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line); Nishi-Sugamo adds the Toei Mita Line. Nishi-Sugamo is at least 13 minutes quicker to Otemachi and Toranomon. A one-room flat also costs about ¥20,000 less at Nishi-Sugamo. On the number of places to eat out, though, Koshinzuka comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Koshinzuka has 38 restaurants and Nishi-Sugamo has 11.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 16 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
